'''Gamorrean tracker's footgear''' were an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Boot/Legends|footwear]] designed for trackers worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were [[black]] in [[Color/Legends|color]] and extended up to just below the wearer's knees.
